title: XROS 4 Kit – 2ml
description:
The VAPORESSO XROS 4 POD KIT comes with the upgraded COREX 2.0 tech, offering a more intense taste and a longer pod lifespan. It features 3 output modes adjustment (strong/stronger/strongest output) and a screen. Pulse mode consistently boosts power, ensuring a great vaping experience. VAPORESSO XROS 4 POD KIT has 1000mAh battery and 2A fast charging, is compatible with the entire VAPORESSO XROS REPLACEMENT POD series. You can adjust airflow with a sliding back button for effortless control of the MTL to RDL vaping experience.

Features

- CORES 2.0 0.4ohm

- 3 power output modes

- AXON chip

- 2A rapid charging

- 4 x fire button to lock

- All Xros pod compatible

Specifications

- Dimensions: 120.80*24*14mm

- Pod Capacity: 2ml

- Resistance: 0.4Ω/0.8Ω

- Battery Capacity: 1000mAh

- Charging: Type-C, 2A

Package List
1x VAPORESSO XROS 4 POD KIT Device
1x VAPORESSO XROS REPLACEMENT POD (4 PACK)-0.4OHM (Pre-installed)
1x VAPORESSO XROS REPLACEMENT POD (4 PACK)-0.8OHM (In box)
1x Type-C Charging Cable
1x Reminder Card
1x User Manual & Warranty Card
